description: South African government tenders and RFQs: searches open tenders from national and provincial departments, municipalities and state-owned companies published on the National Treasury eTenders portal. Filter by keyword, closing date, category and buyer. Returns tender number, description, buyer, procurement method, opening and closing dates, and tender document links. Updated every 3 hours. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

buyer.description: Part of the buyer's name, e.g. 'Municipality' or 'Transnet'

closing_within_days.description: Only tenders closing within N days (1-365)
